content_sections.text: Duration of appointment is 11 months in the ISRO funded project (1+1 years).

content_sections.text: Interested and eligible candidates should apply online by visiting the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati. Carefully follow instructions and guidelines provided on the portal and search for the project title. Apply on or before 3 December 2026.

content_sections.text: Candidates will not be sent any call letter separately.
